additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407046-DC/Si-D/QA-[MP / N7 160345959] Unable to charger the vehicle CRM:00641001090
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the logs and found that:
Sun, 16 Feb 2025 14:37:09 GMT
2025-02-16, 14:37:08
2025-02-16T14:37:08.445957+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/0b0d3d1f8385[736]: PLC-Error-Flag '
DC_Fuse_DC2_FC9'
changed from false - ('fuse of DC2') to true - ('fuse of DC2')
Sun, 16 Feb 2025 14:37:08 GMT
2025-02-16, 14:37:08
2025-02-16T14:37:08.413658+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC] DC2: Cablecheck Stop: DC Fuse defect
Here, the session was stopped due to DC2 fuse- FC9 error. Hence we need to check the fuse FC9. If found faulty, needs to replace it.
Do let us know if you have any further queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
